name: better-canvas
description: An MCP-enabled Obsidian Canvas editor for ChatGPT and Codex. Preview local canvases, reference selected cards, and sync edits with your vault.

interface.longDescription: Open a local vault, preview its Canvas files, reference selected cards in your existing conversation, and edit through MCP. Based on canvai.
